title: One microphone, two AssemblyAI sockets, one gate
caption: The Voice Agent API owns the conversation. Streaming STT v3 owns the measurement. Neither can write to the record without the other.

nodes.text:
Voice Agent API
24 kHz
turn-taking, LLM, voice,
tool calls

Streaming STT v3
16 kHz
word timings and
per-word confidence

In-browser DSP
pitch and energy
never uploaded

Vocal-certainty gate
dead air, hedging, fillers,
word confidence, arousal
scored against this patient's
own baseline

REFUSED
plus the follow-up question
that recovers the fact
